title: the familiar, again
label: after landfall
paragraphs: 金门以内，萨克拉门托河与圣华金河带来的水穿过整个湾区，最后从这道狭窄的海峡汇入大洋。没有什么能够使人比面对这片海更清楚地意识到自身的局限性。在这样的景象面前，所有的情绪都会像将一枚硬币掷向大海那样微不足道。
在海上飘了二十天，上岸后对所有事都宽容且感激。见到了几年没见的一直崇拜的朋友，说了很多很多，enough for what would normally take a month.

perhaps i had misunderstood curiosity all along as a hunger for distance: unfamiliar shores, the open sea, the migration of winds, the hidden architecture of currents, the slow turning of constellations, all the visible evidence that the world exceeds the self. there is another infinity concealed in what stands immediately before it. in another person's mind, in taste, in memory, in the improbable sequence of accidents and choices by which a life becomes this life and no other.
perhaps the point of going so far into the physical world was only to recover the capacity to meet the familiar with the astonishment once reserved for the unknown.
the pacific had occupied every visible direction. back on land, the world exceeded me at the width of a table.
终于吃上了火锅！感恩梅花猪、雪花牛、鸡蛋面、鸭血、毛肚、蘑菇、豆皮、虾滑、蓬蒿、菠菜、油条，还有小料台和水果，一切除了金枪鱼罐头之外的食物。
